question: Why leftover-hole SAT cubes k=|N-(0)| >= d are UNSAT in under 2s through n=72, and whether that is a short counting proof for every leftover n>=73 cube or only a SAT phenomenon.

published_record.sibling_q4_claim: certs/keep/f4_or_new_certificate.json claims 0.34640; this note does not replay or use that file
published_record.exact_statement: every n-vertex oriented graph with delta+ >= ceil(n/3) has a directed C3

setup.cube: N+(0)=A={1..d}, N-(0)=B={d+1..d+k}, U=V\({0} union A union B), no A->B arcs, Sinz exact out-degree d, lex SB on out-neighbourhoods inside A, B, U
setup.pigeonhole: n*d arcs so some indeg >= d; only k>=d is needed
setup.nplus_count: each a in A needs d outs from (A\{a}) union U, size n-2-k; empties k > n-2-d
setup.slack: sigma = n-2-d-k = |U|-1; each a omits exactly sigma vertices of (A\{a}) union U

obstruction.name: 2-cycle covering on A, plus transitive-tournament at equality
obstruction.statement: A leftover cube is empty by counting when sigma < (d-1)/2 (too few A-omissions to avoid 2-cycles in A). When sigma = (d-1)/2 exactly (d odd), A must be a tournament and every omission sits in A; a C3-free tournament is transitive, so the A-out-degrees are {0,1,...,d-1}, which cannot all meet s_a >= d-|U| = d-sigma-1. The N+ count still empties k = n-1-d.
obstruction.does_not_kill: k near d, where sigma > (d-1)/2. For n=73 d=25 those are k=25..33 (9 cubes). Every n in 73..120 has such survivors.

n73.k35_to_46_reason: sigma < 12, 2cycle-covering (k=46 is also sigma=0, combinatorial UP)

covering_73_120.note: A counting proof of every leftover n>=73 cube would close the exact finite statement past q3. This count only closes the high-k half.

why_high_k_sat_is_easy.mechanism: The covering count is a global pigeonhole on A-omissions. Kissat derives it from Sinz exact-degree plus 2-cycle clauses. No lex SB is required.

n21_k12_nosb.note: sigma=0: each a must take all of A, bidirectional 2-cycles. Combinatorial UP also fires (deg-under after forcing).

n73_k34_sb.note: equality case; CDCL still walks the Sinz counters, not 0-conflict at this order

why_k_near_d_sat_is_easy.mechanism: lex SB on out-neighbourhoods, not a linear count. With SB, CDCL proofs stay at tens to a few thousand conflicts. Without SB the same cube is a large UNKNOWN.

n21_k7_decisions_0.note: full CNF is not UP-unsat; preprocess does not finish the k=d cube

n73_k25_sb.note: same easy regime as q3 n=72; first leftover hole is SAT-easy with SB

why_clean_counting_failed_for_survivors.combinatorial_UP: Arc-variable unit propagation (forced/forbidden arcs + exact degree + triangles, no Sinz, no lex) only empties sigma=0. On n=21 k=7 it leaves 331 undecided arcs. Failed-literal probing on those arcs also fails. The covering pigeonhole is global: no single arc is implied.

linear_relaxation.model: [0,1] arc variables, exact out-degree, x_ij+x_ji<=1, x_ij+x_jk+x_ki<=2, cube units
linear_relaxation.n21_k7_full: feasible (0.03s) — no Farkas / linear counting proof
linear_relaxation.n21_k10_no_triangles: infeasible — covering is linear once sigma < (d-1)/2
linear_relaxation.n73_k25_A_union_U_triangles: feasible (0.21s, 47 vertices). The core A-degree constraints plus C3 inequalities do not empty the cube fractionally.
linear_relaxation.n73_k34_A_union_U_triangles: feasible. Equality is integral: a 1/2-regular fractional tournament satisfies the triangle inequalities and the degree bounds; only 0-1 + C3-free forces a transitive tournament.

why_clean_counting_failed_for_survivors.shen_style_first_moment: Shen 3-sqrt(7)~0.354 does not reach d=ceil(n/3). The extra hypothesis k>=d shrinks U to at most n-1-2d, which is what makes the covering count work at high k, but leaves slack sigma~(n-2-2d) ~ n/3 at k=d.
why_clean_counting_failed_for_survivors.lex_is_wlog_not_a_count: Lex SB is a legal relabelling. It is not a degree or triangle identity. A short written proof would have to argue inside the lex-ordered out-neighbourhoods of A; the 16–5244 conflict DRATs are not that argument.

unit_propagation_checker.kills: sigma=0 cubes only, matching kissat 0-conflict DRATs
unit_propagation_checker.certificate_path: Still encode.py + kissat + drat-trim. Covering-killed cubes produce tiny or 0-conflict DRATs. Survivor cubes at n=73 k=25 already finish in 1.08s with SB; a custom UP engine is slower to write than that run and does not prove them.

soundness_reminder.n21_d6_k6: SAT, checked C3-free 6-outregular model; encoder is not vacuous
soundness_reminder.n73_d24_circulant: cyclic degree floor((n-1)/3)=24, not a counterexample to ceil(n/3)=25; lives at k=24 < d

status.residue: covering leaves k=d .. n-3-d-floor((d-1)/2) at every n=73..120; those cubes are SAT-easy with lex SB (n=73 k=25: 5244 conflicts, 1.08s) but have no stored DRAT from this note and no written counting proof
